title: assets/1
description: The manifest of library assets that are not committed (`manifold_config_repo/assets.json`): for each, where it is placed under the engine-asset library, how it is identified (a digest), and where it comes from. `scripts/bootstrap.py assets` materializes the entries as real files and verifies each digest.

assets.description: One entry per asset, a file or a directory.

path.description: Where the asset is placed, relative to `manifold_config_repo/`, POSIX separators, never leaving it (for example `demos/<Name>/scenes/<scene>`).

kind.description: `file` (one file) or `directory` (a folder of files, such as a scene directory).

digest.description: `sha256:` + 64 lowercase hex digits: for a `file` the sha256 of its bytes; for a `directory` its `dirhash/1` digest (manifold_contracts/README.md). A layer file that references the asset stamps the same value.

size.description: The asset's size in bytes (for a directory, the total of its files).

source.description: Where the asset's bytes come from.

kind.description: The kind of source. `zip`: members of a zip archive, read in place.

archive.description: The archive's path; `{dirsig}` stands for the DIRSIG installation the repository links (`external/dirsig`), for example `{dirsig}/demos/zips/<Name>.zip`.

prefix.description: For a `file`, the member's path inside the archive; for a `directory`, the directory prefix inside the archive whose members are placed below `path`.

members.description: For a `directory`, the members to place, relative to `prefix` (default: every member under it). Their relative paths are kept below `path`.
